concepts.note: The space outside the border. Never "Espaço", which names the Space section (margin and padding together).

The space inside the border. pt-BR: "Espaçamento interno" (DEC-67, the user's review of 2026-10-05: the English word stood beside "Margem" in the same box), never "Preenchimento", which is the SVG fill; Figma's Portuguese help calls it "Espaçamento".

The space between the children of a flex or grid container. pt-BR: "Espaçamento entre" (DEC-67; Figma's Portuguese help: "Espaçamento entre"), never "Espaçamento" alone, which reads as margin or padding; "entre" and "interno" tell it from the padding.
The background colour of a box. Its gradient and image layers are "Background layers" / "Camadas de fundo".
The SVG fill only; a box has a Background, never a Fill.
The SVG stroke only; a box has a Border.
The border of a box: width, style and colour of each side.
The rounding of the corners of a box.
The line drawn outside the border that takes no space.
The transparency of the whole element.
How long an animation runs. The animation settings label it the same word.
How long an animation waits before it starts.
How many times an animation runs; the keyword is infinite.
Which way an animation runs (normal, reverse, alternate) and whether it restarts from the other end.
What the element shows before the animation starts and after it ends.
How an animation speeds up and slows down between its keyframes.
Whether an animation runs or is paused.
